description.en: Open the Explorer at Dimetrodon to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开异齿龙，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dimetrodon time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的异齿龙时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 哺乳动物起源证据比较

description.en: Compare Dimetrodon and Morganucodonta through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较异齿龙与摩尔根兽类；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 悉尼矿组 Echinerpeton 神经棘窗口

description.en: Open the map at the approximately 307 Ma Sydney Mines Formation sample for ROM VP 83326, compared with Echinerpeton intermedium paratype RM 10057, beside Mann and Reisz's locator-bearing claim.
description.zh: 在约 307 Ma 的悉尼矿组样本处打开地图，结合 ROM VP 83326 与 Echinerpeton intermedium 副模 RM 10057 的比较，检查 Mann 与 Reisz 带精确定位的声明。

limitations: ROM VP 83326 is a referred neural spine from the Sydney Mines Formation (~308.5–305.5 Ma), less than 25 feet above the Lloyd Cove coal seam near Florence, Nova Scotia; taxonomic comparison and sail-function discussion remain bounded to the cited sample. This is not a global synapsid FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, observed behaviour, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

title.zh: Riograndia 组合带颌关节窗口

description.en: Open the map around the approximately 225.42 Ma Riograndia Assemblage Zone sample in the Candelária Sequence to inspect the named Brasilodon and Riograndia μCT evidence.
description.zh: 在约 225.42 Ma 的 Candelária 层序 Riograndia 组合带样本附近打开地图，检查具名 Brasilodon 与 Riograndia 的 μCT 证据。

limitations: The study samples nine Brasilodon specimens and nine Riograndia specimens from the Riograndia Assemblage Zone of the Candelária Sequence, Santa Maria Supersequence, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil; 225.42 Ma is a rounded dated assemblage context. Homoplastic jaw-joint evolution is a sampled anatomical result, not a global cynodont FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, observed behaviour, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

description.en: Open a rounded Jurassic mammaliaform window spanning Dianoconodon youngi holotype IVPP V4257 and Feredocodon chowi paratype IMMNH-PV01925 to inspect the comparative jaw–ear claim.
description.zh: 打开覆盖 Dianoconodon youngi 正模 IVPP V4257 与 Feredocodon chowi 副模 IMMNH-PV01925 的侏罗纪哺乳形类约略窗口，检查比较性的颌—耳声明。

limitations: The paired fossils come from the Lufeng Formation of Yunnan and Daohugou Beds of Inner Mongolia, China, across separate Jurassic horizons; the 201–164 Ma selector is a rounded comparative sample window, not one shared age. Load-bearing reduction is inferred from preserved anatomy and models, not an ancestor–descendant sequence, global FAD/LAD, complete distribution, observed behaviour, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

title.zh: Liaoconodon 麦氏软骨发育窗口

description.en: Open the source-bounded Jiufotang Formation window for holotype IVPP V16051 while reading the linked mouse and Monodelphis developmental experiment as mechanism context.
description.zh: 打开正模 IVPP V16051 所在有来源边界的九佛堂组窗口，同时将小鼠与 Monodelphis 发育实验作为机制背景阅读。

limitations: The fossil anchor is near-complete Liaoconodon hui holotype IVPP V16051 from the Jiufotang Formation near Jianchang, Liaoning (121.4–113.2 Ma); c-Fos mutant mice and Monodelphis domestica experiments are living developmental models, not fossil observations. Neither the models nor the sampled markers establish a global range, direct ancestry, observed fossil behaviour, or exact specimen-marker co-location.
